'''''Anomobryum''''' is a genus of [[mosses]] belonging to the family [[Bryaceae]].<ref name="GBIF">{{cite web |title=Anomobryum Schimp. |url=https://www.gbif.org/species/2672849 |website=www.gbif.org |access-date=17 February 2021 |language=en}}</ref>

The genus was first described by [[Wilhelm Philippe Schimper]].<ref name="GBIF" />

The genus has [[cosmopolitan distribution]].<ref name="GBIF" />
